Test Case Title: Verify successful appointment booking with valid details
Preconditions: User is registered and logged into the application. Provider has available slots.
Test Steps:
1. Login to the application.
2. Navigate to Appointment Booking.
3. Select a service provider.
4. Select a valid future date.
5. Choose an available time slot.
6. Click Book Appointment.
Expected Result: Appointment should be booked successfully and a confirmation message should be displayed with booking details.

Test Case Title: Verify appointment booking with a past date
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Appointment Booking.
2. Select a provider.
3. Select a past date.
4. Choose any available time slot.
5. Click Book Appointment.
Expected Result: System should not allow booking and should display a validation message indicating an invalid appointment date.

Test Case Title: Verify booking without selecting a time slot
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Appointment Booking.
2. Select a provider.
3. Select a valid future date.
4. Do not select a time slot.
5. Click Book Appointment.
Expected Result: System should display a validation message asking the user to select a time slot.

Preconditions: User already has a confirmed appointment for the same provider, date and time slot.
Test Steps:
1. Login to the application.
2. Navigate to Appointment Booking.
3. Select the same provider.
4. Select the same date and time slot.
5. Click Book Appointment.
Expected Result: System should prevent duplicate booking and display an appropriate error message.

Test Case Title: Verify successful payment for booked appointment
Preconditions: Appointment is booked and awaiting payment.
Test Steps:
1. Click Proceed to Payment.
2. Enter valid payment details.
3. Click Pay Now.
Expected Result: Payment should be completed successfully and appointment status should change to Confirmed.

Test Case Title: Verify payment with invalid card details
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to Payment page.
2. Enter invalid card number or CVV.
3. Click Pay Now.
Expected Result: Payment should fail and an appropriate error message should be displayed.

Test Case Title: Verify session expiry during payment process
Preconditions: User session is active and appointment is awaiting payment.
Test Steps:
1. Open the Payment page.
2. Keep the page idle until the session expires.
3. Click Pay Now.
Expected Result: User should be redirected to the Login page with a session expired message. Payment should not be processed.

Test Case Title: Verify payment cancellation by the user
Preconditions: User is on the Payment page.
Test Steps:
1. Click Proceed to Payment.
2. Click Cancel Payment before completing the transaction.
Expected Result: Payment process should be cancelled and appointment should remain in Pending Payment status.

Preconditions: User is on the Payment page.
Test Steps:
1. Enter valid payment details.
2. Disconnect the internet connection.
3. Click Pay Now.
Expected Result: Payment should not be completed. System should display an  error message without charging the customer twice.

Test Case Title: Verify booked appointment appears in appointment history
Preconditions: User has successfully completed appointment booking and payment.
Test Steps:
1. Login to the application.
2. Navigate to Appointment History.
3. Verify the latest appointment details.
Expected Result: Newly booked appointment should be displayed with correct provider name, appointment date, time slot, and status as Confirmed.
